title: Al-Salah: Love, Not Duty
summary: At the age of 7–9, the child begins to understand the meaning of salah but may see it as burdensome. The key: good example, encouragement rather than compulsion, and connecting his heart to Allah through stories and love.
try_this: This week: perform one salah daily with your child aloud, let him count the rak‘at, and praise him for every improvement.
reflection_prompts: How did your child react when you prayed with him?
Which story had the greatest impact on him?
